review: Astra Ultra canonical-date compiler release and subsequent atomic Truss adoption plan
plan: Release Weft 0.4.39 with explicitly selected backend 0.4.41 and compile/backend/IR0.2.7 using existing five-platform wheel workflow; only after actual publication adopt exact matching compiler and logical ABI1.1 atomically on unreleased Truss main. No new native runtime compatibility, security or performance claim.
required_refinements: Version changes must include crates/weft-python/Cargo.toml, crates/weft-python/pyproject.toml AND the weft-python Cargo.lock version. Existing wheel builds use --locked. Keep Rust toolchain, feature list, dependencies and other crate versions unchanged unless separately justified.

Reuse the existing exact-wheel smoke/report/gate pattern. Mandatory Date smoke on all five targets, uploaded report required; no hashFiles-based optional escape. Publisher for stable versions >=0.4.39 must require exactly five distinct Date wheel reports matching the same five baseline wheel names, source commit, version, wheel/module/shim hashes and fixed expected check sequence.

Positive tests must use the genuine captured native-query-bundle without rewriting its original modules/binding, validate bindingJson equals parsed binding and original source/ABI pins, then check compiled protocol/IR/backend, original binding slot and exact Date parameter token/type. Literal, typed and field-equality compilation are scoped compiler evidence, not native execution on five platforms.

Invalid-date refusal must produce no SQL and the expected Date-domain diagnostic. Old026, oldbackend and oldABI controls must be explicit. Recompute bindingSha256 after an intentional ABI mutation, so the negative tests exact ABI rejection rather than a trivial stale outer digest.

Add small publisher omission/mismatch controls using the existing validator style, including missing/duplicate wheel, source/version/pin mismatch and changed check outcome as appropriate; no new conformance framework or weakened existing gates.

Keep current native70/backend40 fixed-runtime release metadata and all old backend pins intact. Add a separate Date backend41 descriptor with target0.5, binding0.5 and exact logical query ABI1.1 SHA 9b67333abf263078e7e7239fe5accc228b063dc2fcc5488ca068d7331986949f. Describe its selection as exact logical ABI, not a new fixed native71 support declaration.

Run all retained standard exact-wheel smoke commands plus Date against the frozen stable0.4.39 candidate, along with existing spec/boundary controls. Preserve the passing current CI requirement and final tag five-platform/publisher gates; do not infer release readiness solely from earlier development-wheel tests.

Retain immutable failed tags/history. Freeze source, build from the final release commit/tag, require exact final-source reports, then publish through existing checks/promotion policy. Local wheel hashes or workflow artifacts are not published adoption pins.
atomic_truss_adoption_after_publication: Freshly download actual published wheels, SHA256SUMS and release reports/pins; verify final source/tag, all five platform results and installed module/shim hashes before deriving additive trusted cohorts.

In one reviewed Truss change update query dependency/compiler version check, backend41/interface027/IR027, ABI1.1 descriptor and query_abi SQL pin, regenerated native manifest, Date caller/native-slot/result validation, exact builder source revision and applicable release workflow/cohort pins. Preserve old released cohorts and genuine predecessor upgrade custody.

Keep changes on unreleased Truss main until native functional/adoption/upgrade and existing installed platform gates pass. Retain existing 1024-operation/performance deadlines and blockers. No SDK38 release, broad valid-schema, browser date, page/date-key, range/arithmetic or security qualification follows from compiler publication.

Use the previously reviewed basic public date workflow as the native adoption gate and retain existing meaningful query/numeric/authority/upgrade controls; never replace original failure checks or force compatible source pins.
current_evidence_scope: Prior completed review established compiler Date2, core328, spec checks and one real four-object paired candidate native test. The browser fixture mismatch was independently repaired with focused1+2 tests; private helper boundary correction passed11 packages/16 controls plus Date2. None of those is a five-platform final0.4.39 artifact or Truss adoption result.
reviewer_actions: Read-only release workflow, version/lock metadata, exact-wheel verifier and current Truss dependency/source checks. No edits, build, native tests, publication or agents.
